import json

import subprocess

assert len(manifest['hashes']) == 3

bindings = manifest['hashes'] | manifest['dependency_hashes']

for argv in ([sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/validate_workflow.py'],
             ['git', 'diff', '--check'],
             [sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/manage_storage.py']):
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
    commands.append({'argv': argv, 'exit_code': result.returncode,
